source_caption_text:
Drake was NOT letting Kai Cenat forget about that $550 Vivet backpack 😭😂 He kept bringing it up and trolling Kai for still not sending him one.

The bag is part of Kai’s debut Vivet collection, which he unveiled at New York Fashion Week on September 12. The line includes clothing, footwear and accessories, with Kai telling GQ he’s been working toward the brand for three years. 

The $550 Streaming Backpack was designed to hold the broadcasting equipment used for IRL streams, bringing a piece of Kai’s streaming world into his fashion line. The collection also includes electrician boots, leather pieces and outerwear. 👀 

Kai might have to hand-deliver Drake’s bag at this point 😂🎒
